description: This file contains unit tests for the UpdateSession functionality of the RialtoServerMediaKeys class, specifically testing success and failure scenarios using Google Test framework.

classes.name: RialtoServerMediaKeysUpdateSessionTest
classes.description: A test fixture class derived from MediaKeysTestBase for testing the updateSession method.

methods.name: RialtoServerMediaKeysUpdateSessionTest
methods.description: Constructor that sets up media keys and key session for testing.

methods.name: ~RialtoServerMediaKeysUpdateSessionTest
methods.description: Destructor that cleans up media keys after tests.

methods.name: Success
methods.description: Test that updateSession succeeds when the session update is successful.

methods.name: SessionDoesNotExistFailure
methods.description: Test that updateSession fails with BAD_SESSION_ID when the session does not exist.

methods.name: SessionFailure
methods.description: Test that updateSession fails with INVALID_STATE when the session API fails.
